notes.title: 2024.09.09 v.1.2.0 Major Update
notes.content:
2024.09.09 v.1.2.0 Major Update

Hello, this is GreenOnionGames.
Additional content will be unlocked after clearing the game.

[h2]Monster Tower[/h2]

Players can test their limits in the Monster Tower.
The higher you climb, the stronger and more numerous the monsters become.
In addition to the existing monsters, 14 new types of monsters will appear.

[h2]Mithril Ore[/h2]

Mithril is hard to find and difficult to handle.
However, a sword made from mithril will be far more powerful.

[h2]Charge Attack[/h2]

Holding down the attack input will trigger a Charge Attack.
The Charge Attack is stronger and can pierce through many enemies.

[h2]Additional Item Options[/h2]

[list]
[*] HellFlame: Summons hellfire that deals massive damage within a certain range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992002/067e253440ec581af5f3f9facc5411f79e0d36e3.gif[/img]

[*] LifeSteal: Restores a portion of health based on the damage dealt when attacking.
[*] AirDash: Dashes forward while in mid-air.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992002/f7778e3fa33861a5de9aa9c37516c1d4b4cc64f9.gif[/img]

[*] VoidWeapon: A portion of the weapon's stats will apply just by equipping it.
However, weapons with the VoidWeapon option cannot be used for attacking.
[*] Penetration: Attacks can pierce through enemies.
[/list]

[h2]Iron-Reinforced Doors[/h2]

Stronger iron doors, much harder to break through, will now appear.

[h2]Enhanced Animal Racing Rewards[/h2]

Minerals and fully crafted weapons will now appear as rewards in animal racing.

[h2]Other Balancing Adjustments[/h2]

[list]
[*] The base damage of Gladius has been increased by 15%.
[*] The damage of CompleteSword has been increased by an additional 10% upon crafting.
[*] The damage increase based on weapon completeness has been enhanced.
[*] The range increase or decrease based on weapon length has been added.
[*] The utility of Luck has been expanded. The chances of obtaining high-grade minerals during mining have increased up to 5 times.
[/list]

notes.title: 2024.06.14 v.1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
Hello, this is Green Onion Games.

The 1.1.0 patch has been updated.
The details are as follows:

[list]

[*] Added Steam achievements
[*] Adjusted in-game difficulty balancing
[*] Fixed an issue where frames drop after multiple grinding sessions

[/list]

[b]Developer Comments[/b]

We are currently developing new content.
We have heard feedback that, although the game is fun, it lacks content.

We are planning and currently developing deeper crafting processes and growth systems, as well as additional content to utilize these features.

As we are a very small development team, we will need a bit of time, but we promise that Forge Simulator will become a more enjoyable and richer game.

Thank you.

notes.title: 2024.06.10 v.1.0.4 - Minor Update, continous playing patch
notes.content:
We apologize for any inconvenience. We have now made changes so that you can continue playing the game even after seeing the ending. However, if you have already completed the game, this update will not apply. We will fix this as soon as possible.

There have been some balancing adjustments.

The dungeon doors were too weak, making it too easy to reach the ending, so we have made some damage balancing changes.

Now, only higher-grade diamond weapons can deal normal damage to the doors.

Additionally, several bugs have been fixed:

Fixed the camera View Point in hidden locations.
Changed the default options so they cannot be altered by enchantments.
Adjusted the Grinder's guidelines to match the thickness/width.
